description: The single public GLOS crib coordinate is a point observation context, not coverage of all Western Lake Erie conditions or a resolved physical intake location.
evidence_basis: GLOS publishes one named station dataset; the repository retains a separate intake-coordinate discrepancy.
additional_data_needed: Independent intake-coordinate reconciliation and additional public observation coverage metadata
notes: Do not treat the station coordinate as the sole intake geometry.

description: The public dataset establishes a station and time series, but this baseline does not establish current operating status or update cadence.
evidence_basis: ERDDAP dataset metadata and public station record
additional_data_needed: Current station status and documented update/cadence metadata
notes: No station retirement or failure is inferred.

description: NOAA's forecast combines satellite imagery, models, and field samples; this baseline does not assign local forecast error or an action threshold.
additional_data_needed: Documented forecast uncertainty and locally adopted decision thresholds
notes: This is uncertainty, not a finding that the forecast is unreliable.

description: Public sources support general drinking-water-manager use of HAB forecasts but do not establish a direct NOAA-to-Toledo operational data handoff.
evidence_basis: GLERL stakeholder statement plus City monitoring description
additional_data_needed: Publicly documented Toledo use pathway or local decision record
notes: The Phase 4A edge remains qualified rather than treated as an automated feed.

description: USGS 04193500 is one representative Lower Maumee gauge and cannot stand for rainfall, tributary, or basin-wide conditions.
evidence_basis: USGS station record and representative-chain scope
additional_data_needed: Additional gauge/rainfall coverage and documented basin aggregation methods
notes: No complete hydrology inventory is attempted.

description: The public chain does not document station-specific ingestion from NWIS into a particular NWPS forecast run.
evidence_basis: NWIS and NWPS public service descriptions
additional_data_needed: Public station-to-forecast provenance or method documentation
notes: Do not infer a missing feed or operational failure.

description: The baseline does not assign a common observation-to-warning update interval across gauge data, forecast products, and NWS warnings.
evidence_basis: NWPS and NWS public forecast/warning interfaces
additional_data_needed: Documented update schedules and event-specific warning timelines
notes: No response delay or probability is calculated.

description: ECHO exposes public facility/compliance information but is not modeled as a raw continuous sensor feed.
additional_data_needed: Underlying monitoring records and reporting cadence for a defined facility
notes: Periodic or self-reported data are not treated as evidence of regulatory failure.

description: EPA and state-authorized NPDES roles are distinct; this baseline does not assign a specific local regulatory decision.
additional_data_needed: Named permit, state program, facility, and decision record
notes: The boundary is organizational, not a claim of conflict or failure.

description: PJM public operating information and EIA statistics do not expose the private telemetry or internal decision detail needed to reconstruct operations.
evidence_basis: PJM Data Miner, PJM Markets and Operations, and EIA public data pages
additional_data_needed: Publicly releasable operator-method documentation at the required level
notes: No SCADA, control architecture, or cyber detail is sought.
